newsitem.title: UK: Software supplier Royalblue plans June flotation.
newsitem.headline: Software supplier Royalblue plans June flotation.

text.p: UK software supplier Royalblue Group Plc said on Monday it was planning to float on the London Stock Exchange in June.
The company, who supplies trading support software for dealers in international financial markets, said its market capitalisation at issue would be between 35 and 50 million stg.
Royalblue said the float would raise the profile of the company and, in conjunction with the company's share incentive schemes, would help atract and retain high calibre employees.

Following the publication of its pathfinder prospectus on Monday, the company said it made a pre-tax profit of over two million pounds to the year end December 31 1996, and its turnover and pre-tax profits had achieved a compound annual growth rate of 50 per cent and 184 per cent respectively in the last three years.
